why: Committed before anything measures them, so a scenario cannot quietly become whatever happened to be fast. The roadmap's known defect for this phase is a 2,000-object diagnostics micro-test presented as platform capacity; the correction is not a bigger micro-test but scenarios that name what they build and what they measure.

scenarios.builds: equipment objects with one value field each
scenarios.measures: time to build and render the object set once
scenarios.why: The first screen a person sees. A plant view that takes four seconds to paint is one nobody leaves open.

scenarios.builds: equipment objects, then one state change per object
scenarios.measures: time to apply a full round of state changes
scenarios.why: A supervision screen is mostly updates. Render cost is paid once; this is paid continuously.

scenarios.measures: time to route every declared connection
scenarios.why: Routing is the superlinear step in the designer, and the one a large plant hits first.

scenarios.builds: objects, then one move command per object with undo depth
scenarios.measures: time to apply and undo an edit round
scenarios.why: Undo depth is bounded; the cost of an edit must not grow with how much has already been edited.

scenarios.builds: a project document of the given object count
scenarios.measures: time to serialise, validate and re-parse the document
scenarios.why: Every save pays this, and a save that times out loses work rather than being slow.

scenarios.builds: site answers where one site in five is absent
scenarios.measures: time to roll up with completeness stated
scenarios.why: Phase 9's shape, measured: partial answers must not cost more than complete ones, or a failing site slows everyone looking at the portfolio.
